description: This file defines a SpeechPipeline for handling real-time speech recognition using AVFoundation and Speech frameworks. It manages audio input, transcribes speech, and outputs recognize segments. It includes error handling, actor-based concurrency, and internal buffer management.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: An actor that orchestrates live microphone input, speech analysis, and transcription, providing an asynchronous stream of speech segments.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the speech recognition pipeline for a given locale, returning an asynchronous stream of SpeechSegments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition pipeline and cleans up resources.
